risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of tenants failing to pay rent, which could have a significant impact on financial results. The language used in the report is cautious, indicating that the company makes estimates regarding the collectability of customer accounts, suggesting a high level of risk.

risks.title: Vacancy Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of property vacancies, which could lead to revenue loss. The report indicates that the company has tenants who may not renew their leases, suggesting a medium level of risk. The occupancy rate for office buildings decreased from 85% to 83.1%.

risks.title: Depreciation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of depreciation of its real estate assets, which could significantly impact financial results. The report indicates that the company uses estimates of the useful life of its assets, suggesting a high level of risk.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of litigation with tenants or partners, which could result in costs and revenue losses. The report does not mention any ongoing litigation, suggesting a low level of risk.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of changes in real estate regulations, which could impact financial results. The report does not mention any ongoing regulatory changes, suggesting a medium level of risk.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to competition from other real estate companies, which could lead to loss of market share. The report does not mention any changes in competition, suggesting a medium level of risk.

risks.title: Cyberattack Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of cyberattacks, which could result in data loss and costs. The report does not mention any specific security measures, suggesting a low level of risk.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the company AAT's 10-K/20-F report.
